name: FINAL AUTHORITY REGISTER NORMALIZATION & D07-D10 RECONCILIATION

decisions.title: Function identity
decisions.conditions: Canonical identity/signature/boolean return unchanged; no ambiguous overload; rich search is separate; final rich identity recorded before implementation.

decisions.title: Input contract
decisions.conditions: Five application inputs remain accounted for; exact rich signature recorded before implementation.

decisions.title: Return contract
decisions.conditions: Canonical boolean unchanged; rich schema versioned/documented; no unapproved fields.

decisions.title: Matching semantics
decisions.conditions: Evidence-established matching only; no semantic, AI, or fuzzy expansion without separate approval.

decisions.title: Similarity model
decisions.conditions: Similarity is ranking only; no arbitrary numeric acceptance threshold.

decisions.title: Threshold
decisions.conditions: No fixed numeric threshold; a future threshold requires acceptance criteria, evidence, and governance approval.

decisions.title: Ordering
decisions.conditions: Default/public ordering for rich duplicate search; deterministic ordering required; changes require contract approval.

decisions.title: Limit
decisions.conditions: Maximum five candidates by default; no pagination contract; pagination cannot be implicit; limit changes require contract approval.

decisions.title: NULL semantics
decisions.approved_contract: Required NULL/blank input = validation error; NULL optional location/region = filter not applied; NULL database field = does not match; NULL similarity = not duplicate evidence; non-NULL similarity precedes NULL when ordering requires.
decisions.conditions: NULL behavior deterministic; invalid input cannot silently become successful empty results.

decisions.title: Error semantics
decisions.approved_contract: Invalid required input = validation error; valid input/no duplicate = success with isDuplicate=false and duplicates=[]; database error = error; permission/RLS error = authorization error; timeout = timeout/error.
decisions.conditions: Database failure is not no duplicate; database errors and timeouts must not become isDuplicate=false.

decisions.title: Security model
decisions.conditions: SECURITY DEFINER requires separate security review and approval; no implicit privilege escalation.

decisions.title: RLS
decisions.conditions: RLS enforced; no bypass or privileged authorization circumvention.

decisions.title: Data visibility scope
decisions.conditions: Caller-authorized records only; no global visibility or invented tenant/cross-scope model.

decisions.title: Performance target
decisions.conditions: Measure, explain, validate, then index; performance targets and validation required.

decisions.title: Index strategy
decisions.conditions: No speculative index; query-plan/workload evidence and separate authorization required.

decisions.title: Migration strategy
decisions.conditions: Non-Production implementation/validation only after consistency validation; Production migration unauthorized.

decisions.title: Rollback
decisions.conditions: Rollback defined and testable before authorized non-Production migration; canonical function preserved.

decisions.title: Baseline impact
decisions.conditions: Production baseline immutable; any future revision is a separate gate.

decisions.title: Deployment boundary
decisions.conditions: Production migration and deployment require separate explicit authorization.

implementation_boundary_note: Governance reconciliation PASS does not authorize implementation, migration, or Production deployment. A separate implementation gate remains required.
